name: KiCad MCP Pro
description: Connect KiCad to the canonical KiCad MCP Pro backend with local context and safe approvals.
description_full: KiCad MCP Pro companion integration for the KiCad Plugin and Content Manager. The companion publishes the active board/project context to a separately installed, loopback-only KiCad MCP Pro backend and preserves the backend's existing authentication and write-approval boundaries. The backend remains available through uvx, PyPI, desktop, Docker, and other supported distribution paths.
